docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,200.00 FILED BY JAMISON,DAVID AS TO DEFENDANT WILLIAM,B.WILLIAM ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-05-1994 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 02
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL
CERT. RECEIPT TO WILLIAM B. WILLIAM RETURNED SIGNED.
